response:
关闭开关时，“邮寄地址明细”会隐藏并保留当前值；隐藏字段不参与必填校验。按钮只会准备一份可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="邮寄地址")
toggle = Switch(label="填写邮寄明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="收件人姓名", bind=$name, required=true)
detailField = TextField(label="邮寄地址明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此表单的可编辑草稿。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
